license_required.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

name.value: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners
name.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

type.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

degree_required.value: valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board
degree_required.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board

degree_level.quote: "Physician" means a natural person who is the holder of an allopathic (M.D.) degree or an osteopathic (D.O.) degree from a medical college in good standing with the board

school_approval_basis.quote: a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board

credential_pegged.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board

required.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board or have been actively engaged in the practice of medicine, in a manner determined by the board to have been satisfactory, for not less than four years under a temporary permit issued pursuant to R.S. 37:1275

experience_source.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board or have been actively engaged in the practice of medicine, in a manner determined by the board to have been satisfactory, for not less than four years under a temporary permit issued pursuant to R.S. 37:1275

exams.name: Medical licensing examination
exams.notes: Board may design or administer its own examination, or use examinations from any national examining agency, public or private.
exams.quote: Pass an examination which the board deems sufficient to test the applicant's fitness to practice medicine in this state. The board may design or administer its own examination, or it may use examinations from any national examining agency, either public or private

interval_years.quote: Every license issued under this Part shall be renewed annually upon payment of the required renewal fee.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The renewal of any license, certificate, registration, or permit issued by the board shall not exceed three hundred dollars.

required.quote: The board shall have the authority to establish and determine by rule minimum requirements relative to continuing education for the renewal or reinstatement of any license or permit issued by the board.

approximate.matched_normalized: have the authority to establish and determine by rule minimum requirements relative to continuing education for the renewal or reinstatement of any license or permit issued by the board

value: sickle cell disease treatment (1 hour, emergency medicine physicians, every 3 years)
nutrition and metabolic health (1 hour, specified specialties, every 4 years)
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require physicians and physician assistants practicing emergency medicine to complete an initial one-hour continuing education course on the treatment of sickle cell disease... The board shall require physicians and physician assistants practicing family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, psychiatry, endocrinology, gastroenterology, cardiology, oncology, rheumatology, neurology, nephrology, dermatology, pulmonology, surgery, immunology, hematology, obstetrics, and gynecology to complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years.

available.quote: The board may issue a license as provided for in R.S. 37:1274, without examination in this state, to any applicant possessing a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, or osteopathy in any other state of the United States provided the board is satisfied that the license from the other state is based upon an examination and other requirements substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Part.

requirements.value: Applicant must possess a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine in another U.S. state, based on examination and requirements substantially equivalent to Louisiana's requirements.
requirements.quote: any applicant possessing a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, or osteopathy in any other state of the United States provided the board is satisfied that the license from the other state is based upon an examination and other requirements substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Part.

exists.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part

credential_type.quote: the board shall issue to the applicant a license to practice medicine.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part

title_protection.quote: Unlicensed physicians shall not be permitted to collect any fees or charges for services rendered, or be allowed to testify as a medical expert in any court, or execute public or legal documents as a physician, or hold any medical office, or be recognized by the state or parish or municipal corporation as a physician

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty/nolo contendere plea to a felony under Louisiana or federal law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge constituting a felony under the laws of Louisiana or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty/nolo contendere plea to any crime arising out of or connected with the practice of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any criminal charge arising out of or in connection with the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining a diploma, license, or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit pertaining to this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony or false sworn information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false testimony before the board or providing false sworn information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or recurring abuse of central nervous system drugs, including alcohol.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or recurring abuse of drugs, including alcohol, which affect the central nervous system and which are capable of inducing physiological or psychological dependence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances without legitimate medical justification or in an illegal or illegitimate manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering legally controlled substances or any dependency-inducing medication without legitimate medical justification therefor or in other than a legal or legitimate manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of patients or self-promotion through advertising that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of patients or self-promotion through advertising or communication, public or private, which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or assisting in an abortion in violation of statutory requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, or assisting in the performance of, or procuring or abetting in procuring an abortion or termination of pregnancy during the third trimester of pregnancy or after viability of the fetus, unless the physician determines that such abortion or termination of pregnancy is necessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or submitting false, deceptive, or unfounded claims or reports to obtain economic value.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or submitting false, deceptive, or unfounded claims, reports, or opinions to any patient, insurance company or indemnity association, company, individual, or governmental authority for the purpose of obtaining anything of economic value.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness, physical illness, aging, or drug/alcohol abuse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness or deficiency, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or the loss of motor skills or excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including sexual misconduct, disruptive behavior, failure to cooperate with the board, improper delegation, and other specified acts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, including but not limited to, conduct manifested as sexual misconduct, disruptive behavior, failing to cooperate with the board, failing to maintain independent medical judgment, improperly delegating or supervising, exercising undue influence, enabling the unauthorized practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Medical incompetency manifested by continuing or recurring practice that fails to satisfy prevailing standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Medical incompetency, including but not limited to, incompetency manifested by continuing or recurring medical practice which fails to satisfy the prevailing and usually accepted standards of medical practice in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in exercising privileges provided by license or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided for by license or permit issued under this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisting an unlicensed person to practice medicine or having professional connection with an illegal practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performing any act which, in any way, assists an unlicensed person to practice medicine, or having professional connection with or lending one's name to an illegal practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, accepting, or receiving anything of economic value for patient referrals or for prescribing medications or devices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, accepting, or receiving anything of economic value in return for and based on the referral of patients to another person, firm, or corporation or in return for the prescription of medications or medical devices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistent violation of federal or state laws relative to control of social diseases.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Persistent violation of federal or state laws relative to control of social diseases.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Utilizing a physician's assistant without required approval or permitting activities outside designated scope.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Utilizing a physician's assistant without approval and recordation as required by law or permitting a physician's assistant, within his employment, to conduct activities outside of the designated scope of the assistant's approval and registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to examination by a board-appointed examining committee regarding physical and mental fitness.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to the examinations and inquiry of an examining committee of physicians appointed or designated by the board to inquire into the physician's physical and mental fitness and ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to exercise professional care to encourage or sustain the life of a viable infant aborted alive.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, by any physician or person performing, inducing or assisting an abortion, to exercise that degree of professional care and diligence and failure to take such measures as may constitute good medical practice, necessary to encourage or sustain the life and health of an aborted viable infant, when the death of the infant results.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension, or surrender of license by another state's licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state to issue or renew a license, permit, or certificate to practice medicine in that state or the revocation, suspension, or other restriction imposed on a license, permit, or certificate issued by such licensing authority which prevents or restricts practice in that state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any board rules and regulations or any provision of the relevant statutes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rules and regulations of the board, or any provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to self-report in writing to the board any personal action constituting a violation of the Part within thirty days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a physician to self-report in writing to the board any personal action which constitutes a violation of this Part within thirty days of the occurrence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as board certified without satisfying all statutory criteria.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to the public in any manner as being certified by a public or private board including but not limited to a multidisciplinary board or "board certified", unless all of the following criteria are satisfied

definition_quote.value: the holding out of one's self to the public as being engaged in the business of, or the actual engagement in, the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means; or the examining, either gratuitously or for compensation, of any person or material from any person for such purpose
definition_quote.quote: the holding out of one's self to the public as being engaged in the business of, or the actual engagement in, the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being

drug_authority.value: Use of any drug, instrument or force in the practice of medicine
drug_authority.quote: whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means

value: post graduate training registration or permit
license_status_types.quote: Any initial restricted, provisional, or temporary license, certificate, registration, or permit issued by the board to a physician, including but not limited to an institutional license or permit, graduate education temporary permit, military physician permit, military intern permit, mini-residency preceptorship permit, post graduate training registration or permit, dispensing registration, reduced fee license, or visiting physician permit

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates may be licensed if they hold a medical doctorate from an acceptable international program, are in good standing in their licensing country, have completed residency or practiced as a physician for at least 5 years in their licensing country, are a US or Canadian citizen or legally entitled to work in the US, and have an offer of employment at a licensed hospital facility in Louisiana.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The board may grant a license to practice medicine in this state to an international medical graduate who satisfies all of the following criteria: (1) Has been granted a medical doctorate or substantially similar degree by an international medical program of good standing... (3) Has completed a residency or substantially similar post-graduate medical training in the individual's licensing country or practiced as a medical professional performing the duties of a physician in the individual's licensing country for no less than five years.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: No physician practicing telemedicine shall prescribe any controlled dangerous substance prior to conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination, except as authorized by rule or when treating patients at licensed healthcare facilities with DEA registration.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: no physician practicing telemedicine pursuant to this Subsection shall prescribe any controlled dangerous substance prior to conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination of the patient as determined by the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians practicing telemedicine generally may not prescribe controlled dangerous substances without an appropriate in-person patient history or physical exam, except when the patient is at a licensed healthcare facility that holds a current DEA registration, in which case the physician may prescribe any controlled dangerous substance without in-person examination.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The physician shall be authorized to prescribe any controlled dangerous substance without necessity of conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination of the patient as otherwise would be required by R.S. 37:1271(B)(2).

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The board shall issue a telemedicine license to allow the practice of medicine across state lines to an applicant who holds a full and unrestricted license to practice medicine in another state or territory of the United States.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby recognized and enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: the board shall charge and collect an additional annual fee of twenty-five dollars from each physician to be utilized for the identification, monitoring, assistance, and procurement of treatment of physicians suffering from substance abuse, chemical dependency, psychiatric conditions, or physical deficiencies which may interfere with their ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Any person applying for or accepting a license or permit to practice medicine or midwifery in this state shall, by applying for or accepting said license or permit, be deemed to have given his consent to submit to physical or mental examinations when so directed by the board
